name: Anthropic
intro: Anthropic is a frontier AI safety-focused research lab building the Claude family of large language models. Founded in 2021 by Dario and Daniela Amodei (former OpenAI leaders), the company has positioned itself as the safety-first alternative in the foundation model race, with a $965B post-money valuation as of May 2026 — making it the most valuable AI startup globally. Claude has become the de facto enterprise coding and reasoning model, with revenue run-rate reportedly exceeding $47B/month as of mid-2026.
product: Claude is Anthropic's flagship product, available via Claude.ai (consumer chat), Claude API (developer platform), and Claude Code (autonomous coding agent that has emerged as a direct competitor to Cursor and OpenAI's Codex). The model family currently spans Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Haiku tiers, with deep integration across AWS (primary cloud), Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and direct enterprise contracts. Other key products: Model Context Protocol (MCP, open standard for agent-tool integration), Claude for Enterprise, Claude Science (AI workbench for researchers), Claude for Teachers, and the 'Mythos' cybersecurity model released in limited form to select organizations in April 2026.

funding.source_note: Series H at $965B post-money; co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1, GIC, ICONIQ, XN. Strategic investments include $5B from Amazon, plus commitments from Microsoft and Nvidia. Source: Anthropic newsroom, Reuters, NYT.

name: Enigma
intro: Enigma is a physical AI research lab building foundation models (GEN-1) and proprietary robotic arms for human-robot interaction. Founded in January 2025 by former Unit 8200 researchers Jonathan Jacobi (CEO, Microsoft's youngest-ever employee) and Gal Niv (CTO). Emerged from stealth in July 2026 with a $71M seed round — one of the largest seed financings in Israeli startup history. Approach: invert the capability-first robotics paradigm by running 100+ robots in hangars in Israel and California, where anyone can interact with them to study how humans naturally communicate with machines. Investors include OpenAI/Anthropic/xAI/Cognition executives and researchers.
product: Two main products: (1) GEN-1 — foundation AI model for robotics, designed to make robots more intelligent, adaptable, and easier to deploy across diverse hardware. (2) Proprietary robotic arms (hardware) used both as the company's research platform and to collect the training data for GEN-1. The 100+ robot fleet runs public-facing experiments (painting, sword fighting, chemistry) to gather natural human-robot interaction data at scale. Bet: the bottleneck in robotics isn't smarter robots, it's making them usable — analogous to how the iPhone's touchscreen beat smarter-but-clunkier predecessors.

funding.source_note: $71M seed, led by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with participation from Conviction Partners. Notable individual investors include Assaf Rappaport (Wiz co-founder/CEO), Merav Bahat (Dazz founder) via Stardust, Sarah Guo, plus executives and researchers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, Thinking Machines, Cognition, Factory, and Wiz. Source: TechCrunch, Calcalist, Tech in Asia (Jul 27, 2026).
